main_result.result: Integrated durable attempt reservation into score launch and SLOT persistence. The main SLOT frame now carries an immutable attempt binding. A crash after bound SLOT durability but before sidecar COMMIT can be recovered by reconciling COMMIT from the exact main SLOT without re-running the scorer; a reservation with no bound SLOT remains fail-closed unresolved/no-relaunch.
main_result.stress: One valid reserved attempt produced one scorer call and a bound SLOT whose event digest matched the later recovery COMMIT. Simulated restart reconciled committed_no_relaunch without old permit reuse. Missing main SLOT, tampered attempt binding (even with inner and outer digests recomputed), and legacy/unbound SLOT were all rejected for reconciliation.

measurement_validity_rules: The safe crash order is RESERVE durable -> score -> bound SLOT durable -> sidecar COMMIT durable. Only the main bound SLOT is scientific score evidence; COMMIT is recoverable launch-control bookkeeping.
A crash after RESERVE but before bound SLOT cannot trigger a stochastic retry under the default policy; the slot stays unresolved and the block-level fail-closed missing-slot rule must absorb it.
A crash after bound SLOT but before COMMIT must reconcile from that exact SLOT binding, never re-run scoring.
Attempt binding must be inside the scientific SLOT frame/event digest, otherwise post-crash reconciliation cannot distinguish the reserved attempt from a bypass/alternate result.

An unbound lower-level SLOT cannot satisfy the reservation-aware contract even though the historical base journal may still accept it structurally; active-runtime CLOSE/replay needs an auditor/gate to prevent such bypass evidence from being treated as compliant.
Cross-file atomicity is not required for safety if ordering and fail-closed reconciliation are enforced; it is required only for avoiding incomplete bookkeeping/availability loss.
frontier: Add a reservation-aware CLOSE/replay compliance auditor: for every durably reserved slot, require a valid bound SLOT and matching/reconcilable COMMIT; otherwise force that slot to the fail-closed missing/failure path rather than trusting an unbound accepted SLOT.

Crash-inject the entire RESERVE -> scorer -> bound SLOT -> COMMIT sequence at each writer sub-boundary and verify the only terminal scientific outcomes are exact committed attempt or unresolved/missing=1.
Add writer fencing/flock if actual launchers can race across OS processes, then test simultaneous same-slot reservation/launch attempts.
Byte-execute all persisted artifacts against exact production durable adapter/V3/K-guard sibling files in a repository-local runtime.
Verify real stochastic scorer determinism under attempt_id before enabling deterministic replay; keep fail-closed as default meanwhile.
exact_next_action: Implement a reservation-aware CLOSE/replay auditor over main journal + attempt ledger. Before CLOSE/reporting, reconcile any durable bound SLOT missing COMMIT, reject any reserved slot whose accepted SLOT lacks/mismatches attempt binding, and compute the block score with such noncompliant slots forced to failure=1; then crash-stress this audit so lower-level bypass SLOTs can never enter compliant numerical evidence.
